newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 edges lower but blue chips rebound.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 edges lower but blue chips rebound.

text.p: 0900 GMT - The Czech PX50 falls again at Wednesday's fixing.
* On PX50, 19 shares rise, 24 fall, seven are unchanged.
Czech major issues rebounded at Wednesday's fixing but losses in the broader market pulled the PX50 index down slightly.
Komercni Banka, which has fallen steadily in recent sessions, rose 10 crowns to 1,740, SPT Telecom rose five crowns to 3,360 and Ceska Sporitelna rose one crown to 291.
CEZ was the only decliner among the high caps, falling one crown to 900.
Dealers say CEZ has been hit by fears that the cost of completing its Temelin nuclear power station may have been significantly underestimated.
